Dehydrated Spinach Flakes for Food Manufacturing and Export

Tradenest Naturals supplies dehydrated spinach flakes made in India from carefully selected spinach leaves. Drying removes most of the water while keeping the natural green colour, the leafy aroma and the savoury vegetable taste. The flakes are bought by food manufacturers, seasoning companies, instant food brands, restaurants, importers, distributors and private label businesses that want a shelf-stable alternative to fresh spinach. Our process combines controlled dehydration, sorting, cutting and sieving. The standard cut is a flake of approximately 3-8 mm, which works well in dry mixes, soups, sauces, fillings, snack seasonings and ready-to-cook recipes. For applications that need a fine texture, we also offer dehydrated spinach leaf powder as a separate product with its own specification. As a dehydrated spinach leaves supplier and dehydrated spinach leaf exporter, Tradenest Naturals handles standard bulk deliveries, export packaging and private label work. Contact us to request a sample, the product specification sheet or a commercial quotation.

Product Overview

The flakes start as clean spinach leaves that are inspected, washed, trimmed, cut, dried, cooled and then packed in moisture-resistant, food-grade material. Taking out the water improves storage stability and lowers freight weight, and it gives food processors a steady supply of spinach throughout the year. You can rehydrate the flakes before use or add them straight into recipes that already contain moisture. Compared with fresh leaves, they make factory work simpler: no spoilage, easier stock control, consistent dosing and less preparation labour. The standard product has no additives unless a customised formulation is agreed in writing.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

Tradenest Naturals works to standard operating procedures that cover raw material selection, drying, moisture control, sieving, batch identification and hygienic packing. Leaves are chosen for freshness, maturity, cleanliness and suitability for drying, and foreign material is removed during sorting.
  • Raw material inspection and sorting
  • Cleaning and preparation according to the agreed process
  • Controlled dehydration to reach the target moisture
  • Cutting and sieving to the required flake size
  • Cooling, visual inspection and batch coding
  • Food-grade packing in moisture-resistant, tamper-evident packaging
We can adjust parameters to suit your colour expectations, packaging format and the rules of your destination market. Whether you need the standard flake, a private label container or a custom blend with other vegetables, our team will review your technical brief and come back with what is feasible.

Typical Technical Specifications

The values below are a reliable starting point. Final parameters can shift slightly with the crop season and with customer requirements, and we always confirm them before production. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.
  • Product form: Dehydrated spinach leaf flakes
  • Standard particle size: Flakes of approximately 3-8 mm
  • Fine option: Dehydrated spinach leaf powder is offered as a separate product
  • Moisture: Not more than 8%
  • Purity: Single-ingredient spinach, sorted to the agreed specification
  • Color: Green to dark green, depending on raw material and process conditions
  • Additives: No added colours or preservatives in the standard product
  • Packaging: Food-grade inner liner with outer carton, bag or customised format
Residue limits, allergen status and other parameters required by your market should be agreed with us before the order. Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI and IEC registered, and we do not claim other certifications. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Flavor, Appearance, and Formulation Profile

The flakes have a mild, leafy, green vegetable flavour with a light savoury note. Drying concentrates the natural spinach aroma. The colour runs from bright green to dark green, and the product is free-flowing and visually checked for foreign matter before packing. As a single-ingredient vegetable component, the flakes suit clean-label product development. They work well on their own or alongside onion, garlic, herbs, spices, starches, pulses, dairy ingredients and natural flavours. The flake format gives visible green specks in the finished product, which many soup and pasta brands look for.

Applications

Bulk dehydrated spinach leaves give formulators a lot of flexibility across dry, semi-dry and convenience foods. Depending on rehydration method and recipe, typical uses include:
  • Instant soup, soup premixes and vegetable broth blends
  • Ready-to-cook pasta, noodles, rice and meal mixes
  • Spinach fillings for bakery, wraps, pasta, snacks and savoury products
  • Seasoning blends, herb mixes, dips and savoury sauces
  • Bakery doughs, crackers, breads and savoury biscuits
  • Frozen food, convenience food and ready-to-eat meal formulations
  • Vegetable-based dry mixes and blended greens
  • Garnish and topping blends where visible leaf pieces are wanted
During product trials, manufacturers should check hydration time, water ratio, heat exposure and how the spinach affects the final colour and taste.

Buyer Value

  • Extended shelf life: Low moisture gives a much longer storage window than fresh spinach when packed and stored properly.
  • Cost efficiency: Removing water weight and trimming waste makes transport, handling and logistics simpler.
  • Year-round availability: A shelf-stable format protects your supply chain from short fresh-produce seasons.
  • Consistent dosing: Dry flakes allow accurate weighing, blending and portion control on industrial scales.
  • Reduced preparation labor: No washing, trimming or chopping on the factory floor.
  • Flexible manufacturing: Standard flakes, private label packs and custom blends fit a range of product lines.

Quality, Traceability, and Export Support

Our quality checks begin at raw material intake and continue through drying, sizing, packing and dispatch. Batch coding keeps every lot traceable, and product labels show the product name, lot number, production date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and any required regulatory details. We can adapt documentation to the destination market and the customer's requirements. Tradenest Naturals applies food safety measures, sanitation controls and moisture monitoring under its FSSAI registration, and offers export documentation support. Please tell us about any audit needs, allergen declarations, residue limits or customs documents when you first ask for a quote.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Our standard packaging protects the flakes from humidity, contamination, light and damage in transit. Options include food-grade inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, strong cartons and export bulk bags. Private label and custom printed packaging are available. Shelf life is 12 months from the date of manufacture when kept in sealed, moisture-proof packaging under recommended storage conditions. Final packaging and labelling details are confirmed against the destination and the customer's requirements.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

The minimum order quantity for dehydrated spinach flakes is 5 Kg for standard bulk supply. Private label branding, custom packaging and complex export orders may need larger volumes. Samples can be sent for evaluation before you place a trial order. Lead time depends on raw material availability, the season, artwork approval and any custom packaging run. We confirm it in the quotation once the specification is agreed. To get a quote or sample, please share your target volume, destination country, packaging preference, application and documentation needs.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The MOQ is 5 Kg for regular bulk dehydrated spinach flakes. Private label and special export orders may need larger quantities.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. We follow batch tracking, moisture limits and documented process controls. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We use protective pouches, jars, HDPE containers, master cartons and bulk bags, as well as private label packs. Shelf life is 12 months in cool, dry, sealed storage.

What are the typical specifications?

The standard product is flakes of approximately 3-8 mm with moisture not more than 8%. Spinach leaf powder is available as a separate product.

How can I request a sample or quotation?

Contact Tradenest Naturals with your quantity, destination, application and documentation needs, and our team will send a clear, tailored reply.

Why Source from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals is the food ingredient division of Tradenest International. We offer bulk supply, formulation support, OEM packing and export documentation support from Surat, India. Our approach is simple: clear communication, flexible packaging and careful quality checks. Whether you need wholesale dehydrated spinach leaves for a high-volume production line or a dependable partner for a private label range, we can scale with you.

Standards & references

  • DGFT: Directorate General of Foreign Trade (IEC registration)
